summary: On paper Seattle has the edge (Seattle's defense ranks 1st in explosive play rate, 6.7% allowed), while Arizona's best counter is to finish drives (Arizona ranks 32nd in red-zone TD rate, 58%). x-factor: Jaxon Smith-Njigba gets 35% of Seattle's targets and 49% of its air yards, and Arizona's pass defense ranks 29th.
